sources.citation: Nikulin, Andrey & Rafael Andrade. 2020. The rise and fall of approximants in the Tuparian languages. Journal of Language Relationship 18(3-4): 284-319.
sources.note: p. 286: 'The acute accent denotes stress in Tuparí and Akuntsú and high tone in Makurap' — Mekéns forms are left unmarked throughout the cognate tables (e.g. 'woman' Tuparí ãrã́mĩrã, Mekéns ãrãmĩrã, Akuntsú ãrãmĩ́rã); p. 314: reconstruction of Proto-Tuparian prosody left for future research. Sources for Mekéns listed as Galucio 1994, 2001, 2002, 2011a,b, 2014, Galucio et al. 2017, Alves & Galucio 2007.

sources.citation: Aragon, Carolina Coelho. 2014. A grammar of Akuntsú, a Tupían language. PhD dissertation, University of Hawai'i at Mānoa.
sources.note: §2.5.1 (p. 107): quotes Rodrigues 1999:114 on Tupari-branch pitch accent and adds 'Besides these cases, no other publication about the prosodic analysis for Akuntsú sister's languages is known; rather, the prosodic constructions of the other Tuparían languages are yet to be determined.' Mekens data in the appendix (Siokweriat) not stress-marked.

tone.quote: O sistema fonológico da língua Sakurabiat possui 15 fonemas consonantais e 10 fonemas vocálicos, sendo 5 vogais orais e 5 vogais nasais. ... Todas as vogais breves também possuem equivalentes longos /a:, e:, i:, ɨ:, o:/, conforme Galucio 1994, 2006). ... As vogais longas são representadas graficamente por duas vogais idênticas (aa, ee, ii, uu, oo). A nasalidade da vogal é indicada pelo uso do til ( ) sobre as vogais. O acento tônico é geralmente fixo na última sílaba da palavra, por isso, não é marcado.
tone.translation: The phonological system of Sakurabiat has 15 consonant phonemes and 10 vowel phonemes, 5 oral and 5 nasal vowels. ... All short vowels also have long counterparts /a:, e:, i:, ɨ:, o:/ (Galucio 1994, 2006). ... Long vowels are written with two identical vowels (aa, ee, ii, uu, oo). Vowel nasality is indicated by a tilde over the vowel. Word stress is generally fixed on the last syllable of the word and is therefore not marked.
